Link to the existing no-code AI app builders guide

Version 1.0.0 introduces research support for app-builder code and data capabilities.

- Covers Bubble, Lovable, Base44 and Replit across code export, GitHub sync, backend connections and databases.
- Uses a public, read-only MCP evidence service with dated, source-linked findings.
- Includes guidance for searching findings, comparing products and citing evidence.
- Clarifies coverage limits and cautions against guessing, treating unknown as yes or no, or sending private project data.
